title: Maintainer governs a round from local declaration through sealed archive
summary: A maintainer uses deterministic, role-bounded round commands to create disposable local working state, observe its declared status, and archive a fully closed round as durable governance history.
lifecycle_reason: The round lifecycle is deterministic, human-directed governance; it does not invoke the experimental autonomous controller.

permissions_required: The constitutional role required by each round transition

preconditions: DEVAI adoption has seeded the local and durable round directories
The maintainer has selected an unused round identifier
The repository has a materialized binding authority policy

steps.action: Scaffold the selected round in disposable local state
steps.expected_outcome: A deterministic conforming skeleton is created under the gitignored local round workspace without creating durable governance claims

steps.action: Declare the round under the required role and inspect its status
steps.expected_outcome: The declaration and status are schema-valid, role-attributed, and report only the state actually present

steps.action: Complete the declared waves, gates, close decision, and phase-closure evidence
steps.expected_outcome: The local workspace contains the complete attributable inputs, prompts, audit observations, and closure evidence required for archival

steps.action: Archive the closed round with Architect authority and explicit write consent
steps.expected_outcome: DEVAI refuses every incomplete close; otherwise it seals the record, moves the whole local workspace to the durable round ledger, pins hashes, and leaves a reviewable post-close change

postconditions: The closed round has one schema-valid immutable durable record
The local round workspace is absent after successful archival
No supported round command invokes or promotes experimental autonomous execution

acceptance_criteria.statement: Scaffold, declare, and status are deterministic and preserve the disposable-local versus durable-archive boundary.
Archive fails closed until the binding gates, close decision, phase closure, and complete round record are present.
The supported round lifecycle remains human-directed and does not widen the experimental autonomous controller.
A fresh or upgraded adopter receives the scratch/archive layout and ignore boundary needed to execute the journey.
